## Meta-Analysis of Primary Results

In this analysis, I am doing the meta-analysis of the results from the prior experiment ('Batch 1' or 'B1') with the results from the new experiment ('Batch 2' or 'B2').  

The annotations for the gene names are (Accession).(Gene Symbol).(Annotated Sequence).(Modifications). An example is "O95218.ZRANB2.[K].EVEDKESEGEEEDEDEDLSK.[Y].1xPhospho [S7]".  

The purpose of this study is to compare IDC to DCIS and DCIS High vs DCIS Low for each gene that appears in both protein batches based on annotation (mentioned above) matching.  

A summary of the various genes can be found in the excel file "Phosphoprotein_Meta_analysis_CS.xlsx". In this Excel file, there are separate tabs for analysis of Phosphoprotein DCIS (combined) and IDC Batch 1 and 2 and Phosphoprotein DCIS High and DCIS Low Batch 1 and 2. There are also tabs for meta analysis between the 2 batches for both DCIS vs IDC and DCIS High vs DCIS Low. The DCIS.CCR2high and DCIS.CCR2low groups are combined to a DCIS group for the DCIS vs IDC analysis, increasing the n from 3 to 6 for the DCIS group.  

For matching the gene names between the two batches, the results are:  

Matching Gene Count between the 2 batches = 647  
Unique to Batch 1 = 656 (1303 total)  
Unique to Batch 2 = 4476 (5123 total)  


```{r readdata1, echo=FALSE}

load(file ="W:/Health Services and Outcomes Research/BEC/Brooke Fridley/consult/Cheng.Nikki/R01 DCIS/data/processed_data/Phosphoprotein_processed_data.RData")

data.trans.pprotein.B1<-PProteinData$pdata
miss.percent.pprotein.B1<-PProteinData$Missing.Percentage
annonation.pprotein.B1<-PProteinData$annotation
n.pprotein.B1<-dim(annonation.pprotein.B1)[1]

new.ann.B1 <- paste0(annonation.pprotein.B1$`Master Protein Accessions`,".",annonation.pprotein.B1$`Gene Symbol`,".",
                  annonation.pprotein.B1$`Annotated Sequence`,".",annonation.pprotein.B1$Modifications)
for(j in 1:dim(annonation.pprotein.B1)[1]){
  if(is.na(annonation.pprotein.B1$Modifications[j])){
    new.ann.B1[j] <- substr(new.ann.B1[j], 1, nchar(new.ann.B1[j]) - 3)
  }
}
colnames(data.trans.pprotein.B1)[2:(n.pprotein.B1+1)] <- new.ann.B1

load(file ="W:/Health Services and Outcomes Research/BEC/Brooke Fridley/consult/Cheng.Nikki/R01 DCIS/data/processed_data/Phosphoprotein_processed_new_data.RData")

data.trans.pprotein.B2<-ProteinData$ProteinData
miss.percent.pprotein.B2<-ProteinData$Missing.Percentage
annonation.pprotein.B2<-ProteinData$Annotation
n.pprotein.B2<-dim(annonation.pprotein.B2)[1]

new.ann.B2 <- paste0(annonation.pprotein.B2$`Master Protein Accessions`,".",annonation.pprotein.B2$`Gene Symbol`,".",
                     annonation.pprotein.B2$`Annotated Sequence`,".",annonation.pprotein.B2$Modifications)
for(j in 1:dim(annonation.pprotein.B2)[1]){
  if(is.na(annonation.pprotein.B2$Modifications[j])){
    new.ann.B2[j] <- substr(new.ann.B2[j], 1, nchar(new.ann.B2[j]) - 3)
  }
}
colnames(data.trans.pprotein.B2)[1:n.pprotein.B2] <- new.ann.B2

 
remove(PProteinData,ProteinData,annonation.pprotein.B1,annonation.pprotein.B2,new.ann.B1,new.ann.B2,j)
```

```{r summary1, echo=FALSE}

data.trans.pprotein.DvI.B1 <- data.trans.pprotein.B1 |> filter(group != "Normal" & group != "Normal.Adj")
data.trans.pprotein.DvI.B1$group <- str_replace(data.trans.pprotein.DvI.B1$group,"DCIS.CCR2high","DCIS")
data.trans.pprotein.DvI.B1$group <- str_replace(data.trans.pprotein.DvI.B1$group,"DCIS.CCR2low","DCIS")
data.trans.pprotein.DvI.B2 <- data.trans.pprotein.B2
data.trans.pprotein.DvI.B2$group <- str_replace(data.trans.pprotein.DvI.B2$group,"DCIS.CCR2high","DCIS")
data.trans.pprotein.DvI.B2$group <- str_replace(data.trans.pprotein.DvI.B2$group,"DCIS.CCR2low","DCIS")

data.trans.pprotein.HvL.B1 <- data.trans.pprotein.B1 |> filter(group != "Normal" & group != "Normal.Adj" & group != "IDC")
data.trans.pprotein.HvL.B1$group <- as.factor(data.trans.pprotein.HvL.B1$group)
data.trans.pprotein.HvL.B1$group <- relevel(data.trans.pprotein.HvL.B1$group, ref = "DCIS.CCR2low")
data.trans.pprotein.HvL.B2 <- data.trans.pprotein.B2 |> filter(group != "IDC")
data.trans.pprotein.HvL.B2$group <- as.factor(data.trans.pprotein.HvL.B2$group)
data.trans.pprotein.HvL.B2$group <- relevel(data.trans.pprotein.HvL.B2$group, ref = "DCIS.CCR2low")


tmp.pprotein.DvI.B1<-describeBy(data.trans.pprotein.DvI.B1[,2:(n.pprotein.B1+1)], group=data.trans.pprotein.DvI.B1$group)
tmp.pprotein.DvI.B2<-describeBy(data.trans.pprotein.DvI.B2[,1:(n.pprotein.B2)], group=data.trans.pprotein.DvI.B2$group)

tmp.pprotein.HvL.B1<-describeBy(data.trans.pprotein.HvL.B1[,2:(n.pprotein.B1+1)], group=data.trans.pprotein.HvL.B1$group)
tmp.pprotein.HvL.B2<-describeBy(data.trans.pprotein.HvL.B2[,1:(n.pprotein.B2)], group=data.trans.pprotein.HvL.B2$group)

tmp1.pprotein.DvI.B1 <- data.frame(Gene=rownames(tmp.pprotein.DvI.B1[[1]]),
                         DCIS.n=tmp.pprotein.DvI.B1[[1]]$n,DCIS.mean=tmp.pprotein.DvI.B1[[1]]$mean,DCIS.sd=tmp.pprotein.DvI.B1[[1]]$sd,
                         IDC.n=tmp.pprotein.DvI.B1[[2]]$n,IDC.mean=tmp.pprotein.DvI.B1[[2]]$mean,IDC.sd=tmp.pprotein.DvI.B1[[2]]$sd)
tmp1.pprotein.DvI.B2 <- data.frame(Gene=rownames(tmp.pprotein.DvI.B2[[1]]),
                         DCIS.n=tmp.pprotein.DvI.B2[[1]]$n,DCIS.mean=tmp.pprotein.DvI.B2[[1]]$mean,DCIS.sd=tmp.pprotein.DvI.B2[[1]]$sd,
                         IDC.n=tmp.pprotein.DvI.B2[[2]]$n,IDC.mean=tmp.pprotein.DvI.B2[[2]]$mean,IDC.sd=tmp.pprotein.DvI.B2[[2]]$sd)

tmp1.pprotein.HvL.B1 <- data.frame(Gene=rownames(tmp.pprotein.HvL.B1[[1]]),
                         DCIS.Low.n=tmp.pprotein.HvL.B1[[1]]$n,DCIS.Low.mean=tmp.pprotein.HvL.B1[[1]]$mean,DCIS.Low.sd=tmp.pprotein.HvL.B1[[1]]$sd,
                         DCIS.High.n=tmp.pprotein.HvL.B1[[2]]$n,DCIS.High.mean=tmp.pprotein.HvL.B1[[2]]$mean,DCIS.High.sd=tmp.pprotein.HvL.B1[[2]]$sd)
tmp1.pprotein.HvL.B2 <- data.frame(Gene=rownames(tmp.pprotein.HvL.B2[[1]]),
                         DCIS.Low.n=tmp.pprotein.HvL.B2[[1]]$n,DCIS.Low.mean=tmp.pprotein.HvL.B2[[1]]$mean,DCIS.Low.sd=tmp.pprotein.HvL.B2[[1]]$sd,
                         DCIS.High.n=tmp.pprotein.HvL.B2[[2]]$n,DCIS.High.mean=tmp.pprotein.HvL.B2[[2]]$mean,DCIS.High.sd=tmp.pprotein.HvL.B2[[2]]$sd)


pprotein.LM.results.DvI.B1<-matrix(NA,nrow=n.pprotein.B1, ncol=4)
dimnames(pprotein.LM.results.DvI.B1)[[2]]<-c("Gene", "Beta", "SE_Beta","T.Test.P.Value")
pprotein.LM.results.DvI.B2<-matrix(NA,nrow=n.pprotein.B2, ncol=4)
dimnames(pprotein.LM.results.DvI.B2)[[2]]<-c("Gene", "Beta", "SE_Beta","T.Test.P.Value")

pprotein.LM.results.HvL.B1<-matrix(NA,nrow=n.pprotein.B1, ncol=4)
dimnames(pprotein.LM.results.HvL.B1)[[2]]<-c("Gene", "Beta", "SE_Beta","T.Test.P.Value")
pprotein.LM.results.HvL.B2<-matrix(NA,nrow=n.pprotein.B2, ncol=4)
dimnames(pprotein.LM.results.HvL.B2)[[2]]<-c("Gene", "Beta", "SE_Beta","T.Test.P.Value")

for(i in 1:n.pprotein.B1){
  fit1.pprotein.DvI.B1<-lm(data.trans.pprotein.DvI.B1[,i+1]~as.factor(data.trans.pprotein.DvI.B1$group))
  fit2.pprotein.DvI.B1<-summary(fit1.pprotein.DvI.B1)
  
  pprotein.LM.results.DvI.B1[i,1]<-dimnames(data.trans.pprotein.DvI.B1)[[2]][i+1]
  pprotein.LM.results.DvI.B1[i,2]<-coef(fit1.pprotein.DvI.B1)[2]
  pprotein.LM.results.DvI.B1[i,3]<-fit2.pprotein.DvI.B1$coefficients[,"Std. Error"][2]
  pprotein.LM.results.DvI.B1[i,4]<-round(fit2.pprotein.DvI.B1$coefficients[2,'Pr(>|t|)'], 4)
  
  fit1.pprotein.HvL.B1<-lm(data.trans.pprotein.HvL.B1[,i+1]~as.factor(data.trans.pprotein.HvL.B1$group))
  fit2.pprotein.HvL.B1<-summary(fit1.pprotein.HvL.B1)
  
  pprotein.LM.results.HvL.B1[i,1]<-dimnames(data.trans.pprotein.HvL.B1)[[2]][i+1]
  pprotein.LM.results.HvL.B1[i,2]<-coef(fit1.pprotein.HvL.B1)[2]
  pprotein.LM.results.HvL.B1[i,3]<-fit2.pprotein.HvL.B1$coefficients[,"Std. Error"][2]
  pprotein.LM.results.HvL.B1[i,4]<-round(fit2.pprotein.HvL.B1$coefficients[2,'Pr(>|t|)'], 4)
}

for(i in 1:n.pprotein.B2){
  fit1.pprotein.DvI.B2<-lm(data.trans.pprotein.DvI.B2[,i]~as.factor(data.trans.pprotein.DvI.B2$group))
  fit2.pprotein.DvI.B2<-summary(fit1.pprotein.DvI.B2)
  
  pprotein.LM.results.DvI.B2[i,1]<-dimnames(data.trans.pprotein.DvI.B2)[[2]][i]
  pprotein.LM.results.DvI.B2[i,2]<-coef(fit1.pprotein.DvI.B2)[2]
  pprotein.LM.results.DvI.B2[i,3]<-fit2.pprotein.DvI.B2$coefficients[,"Std. Error"][2]
  pprotein.LM.results.DvI.B2[i,4]<-round(fit2.pprotein.DvI.B2$coefficients[2,'Pr(>|t|)'], 4)
  
  fit1.pprotein.HvL.B2<-lm(data.trans.pprotein.HvL.B2[,i]~as.factor(data.trans.pprotein.HvL.B2$group))
  fit2.pprotein.HvL.B2<-summary(fit1.pprotein.HvL.B2)
  
  pprotein.LM.results.HvL.B2[i,1]<-dimnames(data.trans.pprotein.HvL.B2)[[2]][i]
  pprotein.LM.results.HvL.B2[i,2]<-coef(fit1.pprotein.HvL.B2)[2]
  pprotein.LM.results.HvL.B2[i,3]<-fit2.pprotein.HvL.B2$coefficients[,"Std. Error"][2]
  pprotein.LM.results.HvL.B2[i,4]<-round(fit2.pprotein.HvL.B2$coefficients[2,'Pr(>|t|)'], 4)
}

pprotein.LM.results.DvI.B1 <- as.data.frame(pprotein.LM.results.DvI.B1)
pprotein.LM.results.DvI.B2 <- as.data.frame(pprotein.LM.results.DvI.B2)
pprotein.LM.results.HvL.B1 <- as.data.frame(pprotein.LM.results.HvL.B1)
pprotein.LM.results.HvL.B2 <- as.data.frame(pprotein.LM.results.HvL.B2)

conv_cols <- c("Beta", "SE_Beta","T.Test.P.Value")

pprotein.LM.results.DvI.B1[conv_cols] <- lapply(pprotein.LM.results.DvI.B1[conv_cols], as.numeric)
pprotein.LM.results.DvI.B2[conv_cols] <- lapply(pprotein.LM.results.DvI.B2[conv_cols], as.numeric)
pprotein.LM.results.HvL.B1[conv_cols] <- lapply(pprotein.LM.results.HvL.B1[conv_cols], as.numeric)
pprotein.LM.results.HvL.B2[conv_cols] <- lapply(pprotein.LM.results.HvL.B2[conv_cols], as.numeric)

pprotein.results.DvI.B1 <- inner_join(pprotein.LM.results.DvI.B1,tmp1.pprotein.DvI.B1,by="Gene")
pprotein.results.DvI.B2 <- inner_join(pprotein.LM.results.DvI.B2,tmp1.pprotein.DvI.B2,by="Gene")
pprotein.results.HvL.B1 <- inner_join(pprotein.LM.results.HvL.B1,tmp1.pprotein.HvL.B1,by="Gene")
pprotein.results.HvL.B2 <- inner_join(pprotein.LM.results.HvL.B2,tmp1.pprotein.HvL.B2,by="Gene")


remove(tmp.pprotein.DvI.B1,tmp1.pprotein.DvI.B1,fit1.pprotein.DvI.B1,fit2.pprotein.DvI.B1,
       tmp.pprotein.HvL.B1,tmp1.pprotein.HvL.B1,fit1.pprotein.HvL.B1,fit2.pprotein.HvL.B1,
       tmp.pprotein.DvI.B2,tmp1.pprotein.DvI.B2,fit1.pprotein.DvI.B2,fit2.pprotein.DvI.B2,
       tmp.pprotein.HvL.B2,tmp1.pprotein.HvL.B2,fit1.pprotein.HvL.B2,fit2.pprotein.HvL.B2,
       conv_cols,i)

```

```{r meta_beta, echo=FALSE}

fdr_thresh_DvI <- 0.1

pprotein.results.gene.combine.DvI.temp <- inner_join(pprotein.results.DvI.B1,pprotein.results.DvI.B2,by="Gene")
pprotein.results.gene.combine.DvI <- pprotein.results.gene.combine.DvI.temp |>
  select(Gene,Beta.x,SE_Beta.x,Beta.y,SE_Beta.y)
n.gene.pprotein.DvI <- dim(pprotein.results.gene.combine.DvI)[1]

pprotein.meta.analysis.list.DvI <- list()
pprotein.meta.analysis.results.DvI <- matrix(NA,nrow = n.gene.pprotein.DvI,ncol = 6)
dimnames(pprotein.meta.analysis.results.DvI)[[2]] <- c("Gene","Estimate","SE","Lower.CI","Upper.CI","p.value")
pprotein.meta.analysis.results.DvI[,1] <- pprotein.results.gene.combine.DvI$Gene
for(j in 1:n.gene.pprotein.DvI){
  y <- c(pprotein.results.gene.combine.DvI$Beta.x[j],pprotein.results.gene.combine.DvI$Beta.y[j])
  se <- c(pprotein.results.gene.combine.DvI$SE_Beta.x[j],pprotein.results.gene.combine.DvI$SE_Beta.y[j])
  meta.res.pprotein.DvI <- rma(yi = y, sei = se,method = "FE")
  pprotein.meta.analysis.list.DvI[[j]] <- meta.res.pprotein.DvI
  pprotein.meta.analysis.results.DvI[j,2] <- meta.res.pprotein.DvI$beta[1]
  pprotein.meta.analysis.results.DvI[j,3] <- meta.res.pprotein.DvI$se
  pprotein.meta.analysis.results.DvI[j,4] <- meta.res.pprotein.DvI$ci.lb
  pprotein.meta.analysis.results.DvI[j,5] <- meta.res.pprotein.DvI$ci.ub
  pprotein.meta.analysis.results.DvI[j,6] <- meta.res.pprotein.DvI$pval
}
pprotein.meta.analysis.results.DvI <- as.data.frame(pprotein.meta.analysis.results.DvI)

fit.pprotein.DvI<-multtest::mt.rawp2adjp(as.numeric(pprotein.meta.analysis.results.DvI$p.value), proc="BH")
fdr.pprotein.DvI<-fit.pprotein.DvI$adjp[order(fit.pprotein.DvI$index),]
pprotein.meta.analysis.results.DvI$FDR <- fdr.pprotein.DvI[,2]
pprotein.meta.analysis.results.DvI$Sig.FDR.0.1 <- pprotein.meta.analysis.results.DvI$FDR < fdr_thresh_DvI


fdr_thresh_HvL <- 0.01

pprotein.results.gene.combine.HvL.temp <- inner_join(pprotein.results.HvL.B1,pprotein.results.HvL.B2,by="Gene")
pprotein.results.gene.combine.HvL <- pprotein.results.gene.combine.HvL.temp |>
  select(Gene,Beta.x,SE_Beta.x,Beta.y,SE_Beta.y)
n.gene.pprotein.HvL <- dim(pprotein.results.gene.combine.HvL)[1]

pprotein.meta.analysis.list.HvL <- list()
pprotein.meta.analysis.results.HvL <- matrix(NA,nrow = n.gene.pprotein.HvL,ncol = 6)
dimnames(pprotein.meta.analysis.results.HvL)[[2]] <- c("Gene","Estimate","SE","Lower.CI","Upper.CI","p.value")
pprotein.meta.analysis.results.HvL[,1] <- pprotein.results.gene.combine.HvL$Gene
for(j in 1:n.gene.pprotein.HvL){
  y <- c(pprotein.results.gene.combine.HvL$Beta.x[j],pprotein.results.gene.combine.HvL$Beta.y[j])
  se <- c(pprotein.results.gene.combine.HvL$SE_Beta.x[j],pprotein.results.gene.combine.HvL$SE_Beta.y[j])
  meta.res.pprotein.HvL <- rma(yi = y, sei = se,method = "FE")
  pprotein.meta.analysis.list.HvL[[j]] <- meta.res.pprotein.HvL
  pprotein.meta.analysis.results.HvL[j,2] <- meta.res.pprotein.HvL$beta[1]
  pprotein.meta.analysis.results.HvL[j,3] <- meta.res.pprotein.HvL$se
  pprotein.meta.analysis.results.HvL[j,4] <- meta.res.pprotein.HvL$ci.lb
  pprotein.meta.analysis.results.HvL[j,5] <- meta.res.pprotein.HvL$ci.ub
  pprotein.meta.analysis.results.HvL[j,6] <- meta.res.pprotein.HvL$pval
}
pprotein.meta.analysis.results.HvL <- as.data.frame(pprotein.meta.analysis.results.HvL)

fit.pprotein.HvL<-multtest::mt.rawp2adjp(as.numeric(pprotein.meta.analysis.results.HvL$p.value), proc="BH")
fdr.pprotein.HvL<-fit.pprotein.HvL$adjp[order(fit.pprotein.HvL$index),]
```

```{r meta_pvalues, echo=FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=8}

pprotein.DvI.meta.pval.temp1 <- inner_join(pprotein.meta.analysis.results.DvI,pprotein.LM.results.DvI.B1,by="Gene")
pprotein.DvI.meta.pval <- inner_join(pprotein.DvI.meta.pval.temp1,pprotein.LM.results.DvI.B2,by="Gene")

pprotein.HvL.meta.pval.temp1 <- inner_join(pprotein.meta.analysis.results.HvL,pprotein.LM.results.HvL.B1,by="Gene")
pprotein.HvL.meta.pval <- inner_join(pprotein.HvL.meta.pval.temp1,pprotein.LM.results.HvL.B2,by="Gene")


ggplot(pprotein.DvI.meta.pval, aes(T.Test.P.Value.x, T.Test.P.Value.y, fill = Sig.FDR.0.1))+
  geom_point(shape = 21, size = 2)+
  xlab("T-test p-values Batch 1")+
  ylab("T-test p-values Batch 2")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "green", "FALSE" = "black")) +
  ggtitle("Meta-Analysis of Phosphoproteomic results", subtitle = "DCIS vs IDC")+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.10 ,col="red")+
  geom_hline(yintercept= 0.10, col="red")+
  labs(fill = "FDR < 0.1")

ggplot(pprotein.HvL.meta.pval, aes(T.Test.P.Value.x, T.Test.P.Value.y, fill = Sig.FDR.0.01))+
  geom_point(shape = 21, size = 2)+
  xlab("T-test p-values Batch 1")+
  ylab("T-test p-values Batch 2")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "green", "FALSE" = "black")) +
  ggtitle("Meta-Analysis of Phosphoproteomic results", subtitle = "DCIS High vs DCIS Low")+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.10 ,col="red")+
  geom_hline(yintercept= 0.10, col="red")+
  labs(fill = "FDR < 0.01")


```

```{r proteinDvIboxplots, echo=FALSE, fig.width=10}
pprotein.DvI.meta.analysis.results.top <-

for(t in 1:n.pprotein.DvI.top){
  gene <-pprotein.DvI.top.results$Gene[t]
  gene_dat <- c(data.trans.pprotein.DvI.B1[,gene],data.trans.pprotein.DvI.B2[,gene])
  gene_group <- c(data.trans.pprotein.DvI.B1$group,data.trans.pprotein.DvI.B2$group)
  gene_batch <- rep(c("Batch1","Batch2"),each=dim(data.trans.pprotein.DvI.B1)[1])
  df_gene <- data.frame(gene_dat,gene_group,gene_batch)
  p.value = pprotein.DvI.top.results$p.value[t]
  p_lab <- if (is.na(p.value)) "p = NA" else paste0("p = ", signif(p.value, 3))
  plot1<-ggplot(data=df_gene, aes(x=interaction(gene_group,gene_batch), df_gene[,1], fill = gene_group))+
        geom_boxplot(outlier.shape=NA)+
        geom_jitter(color="black")+
        xlab("Group & Batch")+
        ylab("Normalized-Standardized Abundance")+
        coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-1.5, 2.0)) +
        annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, label = p_lab, hjust = 1.1, vjust = 15, size=5) +
        scale_fill_discrete(name = "Group") +
        ggtitle("Phosphoprotein DCIS vs IDC", subtitle =
                  pprotein.DvI.top.results$Gene_short[t])+
        theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=45, hjust=1, size=10))

  print(plot1)
}
```
